name: Work the ST-25's controls: close and open its door, call a turret station, jog an axis with the handle, start the spindle, Cycle Start and Feed Hold

working.role: the pendant: keys, the jog handle and Feed Hold; takes the door's handle over from the steadying hand and shuts it

steadying.role: draws the open door from the headstock end toward the middle; presses Cycle Start while the working hand covers Feed Hold; otherwise rests at the side

phases.what: From the chuck, the steadying hand out to the open door's handle, standing at the headstock end of the opening [proposed: duration_s]
Close the hand round the vertical pull bar [proposed: duration_s]
Draw the door toward the middle, about half its 722 mm, the arm sweeping across the body [proposed: force_n, travel_mm, duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the handle in front of the body

phases.what: The working hand takes the handle and pushes the door the rest of the way, the steadying hand letting go [proposed: force_n, travel_mm, duration_s, the 5 mm]
phases.ends_on: the door within 5 mm of shut, which the interlock reads as closed

phases.what: Let go and drop the hands; step to the pendant (a cut to the pendant's stance) [proposed: duration_s]
MDI, key the station and its offset (T0101) and TURRET FWD: the turret indexes the shorter way round [proposed: force_n, duration_s]

HANDLE JOG, an increment (.1 to come in, .01 and .001 near the work) and the axis key; each click of the handle moves the axis by the increment, a held axis key at the increment's speed [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
With the door shut, key the speed and press FWD to start the spindle; STOP to stop it [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
The working hand's index to rest on Feed Hold, the steadying hand's to Cycle Start
The steadying hand presses Cycle Start, the working hand resting on Feed Hold; refused unless the door is shut and the chuck clamped [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the program starts, the door locks

phases.what: Watch the first approach, the finger on Feed Hold [proposed: duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the tool clear of the part, or Feed Hold pressed

phases.what: Feed Hold stops the axes, the spindle turning on; Cycle Start resumes [proposed: force_n, duration_s]
When the cycle ends and the spindle has stopped (the door unlocks), from the chuck the working hand out to the shut door's handle, right of the body [proposed: duration_s]
Pull the door toward the headstock to the middle; the steadying hand takes it on to its open stop [proposed: force_n, travel_mm, duration_s]
phases.ends_on: the door at its open stop

sources.ref: Haas Automation, 2023 Lathe Operator's Manual: 3.2 (part loading: open the door, do the task, close the door, Cycle Start), 3.5 Run/Setup Mode Restrictions, 4.2 front panel, 4.5-4.7 mode, jog and override keys
sources.gives: with the door open no Cycle Start, spindle FWD/REV or tool change, handle jog in Setup mode only; the doors locked closed during a program, spindle rotation or axis motion, unlocked out of cycle; Cycle Start starts a program, Feed Hold stops all axis motion with the spindle running on and Cycle Start cancels it; HANDLE JOG, the increment keys (each click one increment; the bottom number the held-key speed), the axis keys; FWD, STOP, REV

sources.ref: Haas Factory Outlet (Productivity Inc.), 'Haas NGC Lathe Operator with VPS' manual, rev. 8/2022, from Haas's manuals with Haas's permission: Manual Touch-Off Method, the turret keys
sources.gives: index to a tool in MDI: key in T1 and press TURRET FWD or TURRET REV; start the spindle in handle jog: key in a speed and press FWD

sources.ref: Haas Factory Outlet (Morris Trident TMT), Haas Lathe Set-up course
sources.gives: keep guard doors closed while the machine is in operation

sources.ref: Kurt, 'Double Station Manual Vise Setup' (YouTube), measured locally with MediaPipe Hand Landmarker; borrowed, as no ST-25 footage was tracked
sources.gives: reach durations: the right hand's interquartile range, 0.32-0.67 s

notes: The ST-25 has one door, sliding 722 mm toward the headstock to open (moonshot/library/stations/st25.json); the body model doesn't walk, so the door is shut from the chuck's stance hand over hand: the steadying hand draws it from the headstock end to the middle, the working hand takes it on to shut, and opened the other way round. Cycle Start and the keys are from the pendant's stance, a cut between the two (moonshot/world/lathe_cell.py). Cycle Start falls to the steadying hand as on the VF-2's card (vf2-controls): one hand on Feed Hold while the other presses Cycle Start, Feed Hold right of Cycle Start. No footage of an ST-25's controls was tracked for this card (footage is a bonus, plan §4). Proposed, with reasons (phase numbers count from 1): which hand does what, as above; the door's 25 N pull (its proposed 20 N of friction and a margin), its halves of 360 and 362 mm and their 0.8-1.2 s, and the open in 1.6-2.4 s, since no source gives a force or a time; #1 and #13 0.6-1.0 s, longer than the footage's reaches for the arm's spread; #2 and #5 0.3 s; 3 N on the keys and 5 N on the buttons, the station's affordance forces; #6 3 s for MDI, T0101 and TURRET FWD; #7 3-10 s of jogging; #8 2 s; #10 and #12 0.3 s a press; #11 5-15 s.
